1.name: H
1.text: Fine night today, huh? Very refreshing.

4.name: H
4.text: Actually, don’t tell anyone, but I got a bonus at the shelter job!

5.name: H
5.text: They told me it’s because of my good behavior and for always working hard…

6.name: H
6.text: Hohoho! What world do we live in! You get a bonus for being a decent human being! How silly!

7.name: H
7.text: But I’m not gonna complain! I’ll get me some more lunch!

10.name: H
10.text: Makes me wish for a mug of hot chocolate and some apple pie in front of the family TV...

11.name: H
11.text: But I can only afford this, so I'll have to make do! Hoho!
